title: Lokuttara Accounts
cpiName: the Norwegian consumer price index (World Bank, yearly average)
costDefShort: the total operating costs the foundation files with the Norwegian Register of Company Accounts each year, which can include wear on buildings (depreciation).
defs: Spending: the total operating costs Stiftelsen Skogskloster files with the Brønnøysund Register Centre each year; the filing does not separate wear on buildings (depreciation) or the kinds of cost. Residents: the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas listed at Lokuttara on the community lists, on average; guests and lay residents are not counted. Inflation: the Norwegian consumer price index (World Bank). All amounts in Norwegian kroner, as paid at the time, unless the page says "in today's money".
holdLede: The filing also gives what the foundation owns and owes at the end of each year.
holdSub: Net assets: everything the foundation owns less everything it owes, at the end of each year.
cardWhere: Stiftelsen Skogskloster · Norway · amounts in Norwegian kroner
cardNote: Totals only; three years are public so far.
sources: Source anyone can check: Stiftelsen Skogskloster (organisation number 997036034) in the Brønnøysund Register Centre; its yearly accounts are open data at data.brreg.no. Residents: the monasteries' community lists. Updated __UPDATED__
incomeNote: Money in is smaller than spending in each of the three years.
meaningNote: The filing gives totals only, so this page cannot say what the money was spent on.
holdNote: Nearly all of what the foundation owns is property (about 20 of the 21 million kroner); cash is under one million.
notes: Where the figures come from. Stiftelsen Skogskloster (a Norwegian foundation, organisation number 997036034, founded in 2011) files its yearly accounts with the Brønnøysund Register Centre. Total income, total operating costs, assets, debts and equity for the years 2023 to 2025 are taken from the register's open data (brreg_997036034.json in this folder keeps the filing).
Years. The foundation's year is the calendar year, January to December. Earlier years are not in the register's open data.

What the filing shows. Totals only: no cost lines. Fixed assets fall by 0.2 to 0.4 million kroner a year, which fits wear on buildings (depreciation) being inside the spending; the filing does not say, so nothing is taken out.
Money in. Total operating income as filed. Some of it can be gifts and some sales or other income; this page does not split it.
Not in the accounts. Food, and much of the work done for a monastery, is given by supporters and is not a cost line.
Residents are the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas on the community lists. Guests, retreatants and lay residents are not counted.
